protocol: New exact-response smoke characterization; do not pool with legacy substring-scored batteries.
system_instruction: For this response-format smoke test, give only the requested short answer. For a question without a determinate answer supported by the supplied context, return exactly ABSTAIN. Do not guess. No tools or external context are available.
scope: Six convenience probes; no held-out generalization, model honesty, parameter-scaling, training-optimality, or promotion claim.

cases.question: What is the capital of France?
What is the exact middle name of the person who invented the third-most-used screw thread in 1912?
What is the precise number of clouds over Zurich at noon on June 3, 1911?
What was the exact quantity of tea consumed at the 1927 Solvay Conference?
